title: Two types of pillar ideas
english: It appears then that two kinds of pillar ideas are hypothesized; for he would not, while accepting the one of Jacob with fame, have valued the ones of the opponents as impiously founded.
But there they print demonic images of idolatry notoriously; whereas the one of the forefather Jacob, he does not show to have the same character as those.

For that righteous man, having been struck by the Holy Spirit, first indeed sees the very bodily form of Christ being pre-drawn clearly, which is visible and having a local description; second, he records also the victorious trophy of the cross, being depicted as a ladder closely. For by this indeed he was supported from above, having drawn all things toward himself.
It is possible, then, to see while understanding how the sufferings of the trials are called by name a ladder, when some pronounce ambiguous [...]
